result.title: Efficient Scene-Distribution-Aware Second-Order Optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting
result.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to ACCV 2026
result.summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) optimization updates the Gaussian parameters one training view at a time, tens of thousands of times. Unlike such single-view updates, multi-view batches reduce dependence on individual training views, and second-order optimization reduces the number of updates with larger, structured parameter changes. Because fewer updates leave fewer chances to correct a change that fits only the views used in one update, scene coverage becomes more important for each second-order update. Multi-view second-order updates, however, are expensive. Pixel sampling reduces this cost, but two issues remain. First, selecting views without considering overlap leaves some views redundant. To address this, we propose a view selection strategy that reduces this redundancy. Second, existing work processes the sampled pixels of each view in a separate pass and recomputes alpha compositing for these pixels from scratch. We introduce two implementation strategies that reduce both overheads by processing the sampled pixels of multiple views in joint passes and reusing the transmittance and accumulated color cached during rendering. On three datasets, our method reaches higher PSNR than the sampled second-order baseline in less than half its optimization time, with competitive SSIM and LPIPS.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向 3D Gaussian Splatting 的多视图二阶优化，提出考虑视图重叠的视图选取策略以减少冗余视图，并用多视图联合像素采样与复用渲染期透射率、累积颜色缓存的实现来降低单次更新开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按覆盖度与冗余度挑选视图的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据子集筛选与有限计算下的证据分配提供可核查线索；但该工作属渲染/优化工程，与 latent 推理状态生成无直接关系。
